title: Aged cowboy musician talks to saloon bartender

shot.angle: slight low angle from just behind the bartender's right shoulder looking toward the cowboy's face

subject.headline: Aged cowboy musician at a frontier saloon bar, mid-conversation with an aged bartender

entities.name: Aged cowboy musician
entities.description: The cowboy — a weathered man in his late 60s, deeply lined face with silver-grey stubble, sun-darkened leathery skin, pale grey-blue eyes shadowed under the brim of a worn brown leather cowboy hat dented and stained from years of road use. Lean build, slightly stooped shoulders, broad-chested. Wearing a dust-covered brown duster coat with frayed cuffs, faded denim shirt open at the collar, a dark brown leather vest with a missing button, scuffed brown boots with worn-down heels, a battered leather belt with a weathered empty holster. A large black leather guitar case — road-worn, scratched, with a faded sticker and tarnished silver clasps — leans against the bar at his feet.

entities.name: Saloon bartender
entities.description: The bartender stands across the bar: a stout man in his late 60s, bald with a thick white walrus moustache, wearing red suspenders over a white collarless shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, thick forearms resting on the counter, listening with a composed and measured expression, a glass and cloth in one hand.

subject.action: The cowboy leans forward on both forearms on the bar, head tilted slightly toward the bartender, lips moving in slow deliberate speech, right hand loosely curled around a small shot glass. The bartender leans back slightly, polishing the glass with a slow circular motion, eyes steady on the cowboy's face. The bat-wing doors in the background sway gently, still settling from the cowboy's entrance.

environment.location: Inside a dusty Wild West frontier saloon
environment.description: Dim interior of a frontier saloon — long worn wooden bar counter with deep scratches, ring stains, and a cracked brass foot rail, rows of unlabeled whiskey bottles lined against a large cracked mirror behind the bar, a few wooden stools with cracked leather seats pushed aside, rough-hewn plank walls with sun-bleached wanted posters tacked unevenly, a mounted deer skull above the mirror, warped floorboards covered in dry sawdust, low ceiling of rough-cut wooden beams with oil lanterns hanging on hooks casting warm amber pools, bat-wing doors at the entrance visible in the background still faintly swinging, golden afternoon light slicing through them as dusty shafts across the floor, a beat-up upright piano with yellowed keys in the far corner, empty round tables and mismatched chairs in the background mid-room.

lighting.key: Warm amber oil lantern glow from the ceiling beams
sources: golden afternoon sunlight cutting through the bat-wing doors as long dusty shafts across the floor
lighting.contrast: high contrast with deep shadow in the back corners
lighting.quality: soft rim light catching the edge of the cowboy's hat brim and the bartender's bald head

mood.atmosphere: Quiet, world-weary, sun-baked frontier solitude, fine dust particles drifting slowly through the light shafts, heavy stillness of a near-empty afternoon saloon, intimate low-stakes gravity
